explanation: The theorem says: if each label's sample average of X w is at most B, then the sample average of the sum over labels is at most card(labels)·B. I searched Mathlib for related lemmas. Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul is the plain sum bound with no division by the sample size. Finset.expect_le_expect and Finset.expect_sum_comm (in Algebra/BigOperators/Expect.lean) work with the expectation notation. Here the statement uses ℕ-valued sums cast to ℝ and divided by sample.card. Getting from the Mathlib lemmas to the theorem would mean unfolding expect, casting, swapping sums, and bounding. That takes more than a one- or two-line derivation, so I found no duplicate or special case.
